entries.statement: A reference verifier exists as an installable Python package.
A second implementation exists in a different language (Rust).
The second implementation is maintained by a separate entity, not the specification author.
entries.reason: both implementations sit under one organisation; independence is asserted by neither, and is not publicly documented

entries.statement: Malformed input is refused with a message that names the limit, not a stack trace.
A false-accept rate under mutation is published and reproducible.
evidence: no mutation benchmark found in repo or PyPI metadata
entries.reason: no published mutation corpus or false-accept number was found as of the measurement date; absence of a publication is recorded as such

entries.statement: The project publishes a coverage ledger naming requirements it has not tested.
evidence: no cdp-1 ledger in repository or release artefacts
entries.reason: no machine-readable statement of untested requirements exists; this is the axis this ledger is meant to measure

entries.statement: The format has a registered Internet-Draft.
Third parties have run the verifier and left public records.
tests: 13 listed, 10 marked ran and verified with links

entries.statement: An append-only transparency log with checkpoints is public.
